pages.text: More bound curios. These also only work while you are Branded.
$(l)Blood Toll$() drains hunger instead of health. If you're starving, it takes health again.
When a hit leaves you below $(l)40% health$(), monsters within $(l)6 blocks$() are knocked back and get Weakness I and Slowness I for 5s. Cooldown: $(l)30s$().
Melee hits heal you for $(l)10% of the damage dealt$(), up to 1.5 hearts per hit. Each heal costs a little hunger.
Take $(l)6% less damage$() for each harmful effect on you, up to $(l)30%$().
